name: tripmate
description: TripMate — travel agency platform (Next.js standalone + PostgreSQL, fully self-contained stack)
note: Deploy via Portainer UI with compose path docker-compose.portainer.yml. Internal PostgreSQL is configured by POSTGRES_* alone — DATABASE_URL is derived inside the app at boot. Configure unique local ports if other stacks share the server.

env.name: AUTH_SECRET
env.label: ⭐ Auth Secret — 32+ chars; generate: openssl rand -base64 32

env.name: APP_URL
env.label: ⭐ Public URL users open — e.g. https://tripmate.example.com (NGINX domain) or http://1.2.3.4:3000

env.name: POSTGRES_PORT
env.label: PostgreSQL host port (leave free if only the app should reach it)

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: ⭐ PostgreSQL password — CHANGE before first deploy (volume keeps the initial password)

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.label: External DB URL only — leave EMPTY to use the internal PostgreSQL

env.name: DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE
env.label: External DB only: DDL-capable URL when DATABASE_URL is not (e.g. Supabase :6543 → direct/session :5432)

env.name: STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR
env.label: Local upload root (persists in the tripmate_uploads volume)

env.name: R2_PUBLIC_URL
env.label: R2 CDN base URL (also a BUILD-time input — redeploy with rebuild after changing)

env.name: META_CAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.label: Meta Conversions API token (required together with Pixel ID)

env.name: META_CAPI_TEST_CODE
env.label: Meta test event code — validation only, never in real traffic

env.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL
env.label: Upstash Redis REST URL (shared rate limiting, optional)
